crew.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
crew.title: Avengers: Infinity War

crew.overview: After 20 years abroad, Mark Renton returns to Scotland and reunites with his old friends Sick Boy, Spud and Begbie.
crew.title: T2 Trainspotting

details.biography: Priya started her career in-house where she worked as a researcher, production secretary and script editor before moving into freelance work. Since then she has worked on a number of high-end drama series (The Salisbury Poisonings, Pistol) and feature films (Avengers: Infinity War, T2: Trainspotting) in both production and as a departmental coordinator, which has allowed her to develop a deeper understanding of production as a whole. Her latest credit has been as production manager on Bodies (Moonage Pictures for Netflix).
details.name: Priya Bhakta
